# SsoProvider

An identity provider a person can sign in to Maitento with.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"GitHub"` | GitHub. |
| `"Google"` | Google. |
| `"Microsoft"` | Microsoft: a work, school or personal Microsoft account. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

- Inside [`SsoProvidersResponse`](sso-providers-response.md)
